fields.name: SplitFundingFoundMessage
fields.fieldText:
Credit has identified the following potential payoffs associated to this customer. Use the table below to enter the customer-provided values for each External Payoff and and select which account will be paid off at the time of funding. Only one Lender should be selected to include. For each payoff, upload documentation below showing proof the customer provided the Payoff value.


Validation of External Payoff amounts is required to send Funding Options to your customer if the Customer is in states that require Truth in Lending Act.
